runs.limits: Finite heuristic policy pool, not a proof of global nondominance. Training/validation/stress seeds are disjoint. Shop and phase RNG are floor-seeded; lover calls remain state-dependent. Scenario fixtures are conditional stress tests, not weighted normal-run probabilities. Intervals against the post-hoc best policy are descriptive and uncorrected for multiple comparisons. Bomb/impatience collision is fixed. Policies conservatively reject predicted early-fuse failure.
